title: Remove README CI badge
body:
### What does this PR try to resolve?

I noticed the CI badge in the README no longer works. Seems we don't have an `auto-cargo` branch (anymore?)
I tried swapping to `master` but that didn't work since we don't technically run CI on master.

Doing some googling, I discovered that https://github.com/badges/shields can handle this for us.
I think the shields project is fairly well known and safe, but if their are concerns linking to an external domain, we can always just remove the badge.
